def factor_volume_regime_adaptive_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    is_high_vol, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    weighted_ret = ret * vol_ratio
    sum_wt_ret_5 = weighted_ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    sum_vol_5 = vol_ratio.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    factor_5 = sum_wt_ret_5 / sum_vol_5.replace(0, np.nan)
    sum_wt_ret_20 = weighted_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    sum_vol_20 = vol_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    factor_20 = sum_wt_ret_20 / sum_vol_20.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = factor_5.where(is_high_vol > 0, factor_20)
    df_copy["factor_volume_regime_adaptive_momentum"] = factor.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_regime_adaptive_momentum"]
description: Combines volume-weighted price momentum with a regime-adaptive window. When volume is classified as high by classify_volume_regime, a shorter 5-day window captures immediate trend signals; otherwise, a longer 20-day window smooths the signal. This leverages the idea that high-volume days indicate regime shifts where short-term trends are more informative. The volume-weighted average filters out low-volume noise, and cross-sectional z-scoring identifies extreme momentum leaders.
